parts.name: Provider
parts.description: The list of toasts and the timers. It renders nothing of its own.

props.name: timeout
props.description: The default time a toast stays, in milliseconds. `0` keeps each toast until a close.

props.name: limit
props.description:
The count of toasts on the screen. The older ones past it wait behind, hidden and inert,
with their timers stopped, and they come forward as the newer ones close.

props.name: manager
props.description:
The manager: `add`, `update`, `close` and `promise`. Use `bind:manager` to read it in the
page, or give one to share a list of toasts between two providers.

props.name: children
props.description: The app, with a `Toast.Viewport` somewhere in it.

parts.name: Viewport
parts.description: The region where the toasts land. It makes a div with role="region", at the end of the body, and it renders the snippet for each toast.

props.name: children
props.description: The toast to render for each item. It gets the item; render a `Toast.Root` with it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: portal
props.description:
Renders the viewport at the end of `<body>`, thus it draws above the page. Set it to
`false` to render it in place.

props.name: element
props.description: The bindable viewport element.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer rests on the viewport, or the focus is in it. A tap on a toast, not a swipe, holds it on until a touch outside the viewport.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-viewport
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the viewport element.

parts.name: Positioner
parts.description: Puts a toast with an anchor against that element, as a fixed div. For a toast without one, it is out of the layout.

props.name: toast
props.description: The item from `Toast.Viewport`.

props.name: children
props.description: The `Toast.Root`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The bindable positioner element.

dataAttributes.name: data-anchored
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item has an anchor.

dataAttributes.name: data-placement
dataAttributes.description: The side of the anchor where the toast sits, after a flip.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-positioner
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the positioner element.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: One toast. It makes a div with role="dialog", or role="alertdialog" for a high priority, that is not modal.

props.name: toast
props.description: The item from `Toast.Viewport`.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts of the toast.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description:
The sides a swipe can push the toast out through: `bottom` and `right` by default. One side
per axis counts. An empty array turns the swipe off. A swipe on `Toast.Close` or
`Toast.Action` never starts.

props.name: element
props.description: The bindable toast element.

dataAttributes.name: data-anchored
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item has an anchor. The toast is out of the stack.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending
dataAttributes.description: Present through the exit animation.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present through the enter animation.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present through the exit animation.

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer rests on the viewport, or the focus is in it. A tap on a toast, not a swipe, holds it on until a touch outside the viewport.

dataAttributes.name: data-front
dataAttributes.description: Present on the one toast in front. A toast on its way out drops it, and it keeps the place it had for its exit.

dataAttributes.name: data-limited
dataAttributes.description: Present on a toast past the limit. It is inert, and it waits in the place behind the stack.

dataAttributes.name: data-priority
dataAttributes.description: The priority of the item: `low` or `high`.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-direction
dataAttributes.description: The side of the swipe in progress, or of the swipe that dismissed the toast.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-dismissed
dataAttributes.description: Present when a swipe dismissed the toast, for the exit.

dataAttributes.name: data-swiping
dataAttributes.description: Present while a swipe is in progress.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-id
dataAttributes.description: The id of the item.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the toast element.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The `type` of the item, such as `success` or `loading`.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The message: the title and the description. Keep the buttons out of it.

props.name: children
props.description: The title and the description.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-priority
dataAttributes.description: The priority of the item: `low` or `high`.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the content element.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The `type` of the item, such as `success` or `loading`.

parts.name: Title
parts.description: The name of the toast. It gives its id to the toast as `aria-labelledby`, and it shows the `title` of the item without children.

props.name: children
props.description: The title. Without children, it shows the `title` of the item.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the element. The component makes one when you give none.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-title
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the title element.

parts.name: Description
parts.description: The message of the toast. It gives its id to the toast as `aria-describedby`, and it shows the `description` of the item without children.

props.name: children
props.description: The description. Without children, it shows the `description` of the item.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the element. The component makes one when you give none.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-description
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the description element.

parts.name: Close
parts.description: A button that closes the toast.

props.name: children
props.description: The name on the button.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: element
props.description: The bindable button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-close
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the close button.

parts.name: Action
parts.description: The one thing the toast offers. The press closes the toast.

props.name: children
props.description: The name on the button.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

props.name: keepOpen
props.description: Keeps the toast open after the press. By default, the press closes it.

props.name: element
props.description: The bindable button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-toast-action
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the action button.
